description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
1. (2:30) Hi Pastor Bohr, what is the origin of the black Israelite belief, what is the Bible basis?
2. (11:20) Blessings to you all from Secrets Unsealed! I was listening to some of your sermons and classes and perhaps with the Holy Spirit speaking to me, it hit me that if you check out each part of the armor in Ephesians 6, each part is a reference to Christ. Have you ever had or done a sermon about that? I would love to watch it. Thank you, Pastor Bohr, as well as the other pastors when they are there. 
3. (16:03) I think my question may require you to speculate a bit because as far as I can tell, the Bible doesn’t really answer it. My question is, where was Jesus when the woman got to the tomb on Sunday morning? Afterward, He appeared to Mary at the tomb, and later in the day He appeared to the two disciples on the road to Emmaus, and still later, He appeared to the 11 and others. But I don’t see anywhere where it mentions where Jesus went immediately after He was resurrected. We know that He hadn’t gone to heaven yet because he asked Mary not to cling to Him--not to delay him because He had not yet ascended. But where was He when the woman arrived and discovered the empty tomb? I think Jesus must’ve met with the others who were resurrected prior to them going into the city, but I am just speculating. Perhaps there is something I missed or maybe you know of something Ellen White wrote that could answer my question.
4. (22:43) The question has to do with the parable of the talents, the one found in Matthew 25:14-30 and Luke 19:11-27. So the question is with the account in Luke involving the good productive servants being in charge of many cities and with the evil servant being dealt a judgment that seems to be the basis of the third angel’s message, the mark of the beast judgment scene of Revelation 14:9-10. How do we reconcile or explain these different additional details? Is there actually an end-time prophetic dimension to this parable pointedly in regards to Luke's city rule appointment and also the seeming third angel's message allusion basis?
.
.
.
Join us every Tuesday at 4:30pm (Pacific Time) for our weekly episode airing LIVE from the studio!
Only on SUMtv.org! 
Additional Bible studies are available at SecretsUnsealed.org.
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program.
